documentation_excerpts.text: IBAutomater is an automation tool for IB Gateway v978 and above. It supports starting, stopping and automated logins for IB Gateway. This package is best used in conjunction with LEAN. LEAN handles the automatic login and portfolio construction once you start the IB Gateway.

To get started with IBAutomater, first you will need to get the library itself. The easiest way to do this is to install the package into your project using [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/QuantConnect.IBAutomater/). Using Visual Studio this can be done in two ways.
